channel.title: Violations Watch: new incidents
channel.description: New entries in the open log of reported violations of international humanitarian and human rights law. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Suspected bandits kill three residents and burn down an entire village in Niger State (Punch)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Niger State, Nigeria. Types: Killing of civilians, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Suspected bandits. Reported casualties: 3 killed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2392
